title: RuleChainMetaData
description: A JSON value representing the rule chain metadata.

ruleChainId.description: JSON object with Rule Chain Id.

firstNodeIndex.description: Index of the first rule node in the 'nodes' list

nodes.description: List of rule node JSON objects

connections.description: List of JSON objects that represent connections between rule nodes

ruleChainConnections.description: List of JSON objects that represent connections between rule nodes and other rule chains.

JsonNode.description: A value representing the any type (object or primitive)

fromIndex.description: Index of rule node in the 'nodes' array of the RuleChainMetaData. Indicates the 'from' part of the connection.

toIndex.description: Index of rule node in the 'nodes' array of the RuleChainMetaData. Indicates the 'to' part of the connection.

type.description: Type of the relation. Typically indicated the result of processing by the 'from' rule node. For example, 'Success' or 'Failure'

targetRuleChainId.description: JSON object with the Rule Chain Id.

additionalInfo.description: JSON object with the additional information about the connection.
